name: @xlcore/render-ts
description: Canvas renderer for xlcore WorkbookLayout. Browser + Node.

scripts.build: bun build src/browser.ts --outfile dist/browser.js --target browser --format iife && bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.js --target node --format esm
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run check:loc && bun run knip
scripts.dev: bun build src/browser.ts --outfile dist/browser.js --target browser --format iife --watch
